links.outcome: Readability grade level of ChatGPT outputs versus urologic organization PIMs
links.effect: GPT-3.5 grade 13-14; GPT-4 grade 11-13; CUA 10-12, AUA 8-10, EAU 9-11; all above general population reading ability.
links.quote: GPT-3.5 had the worst readability scores at grade 13-14 and GPT-4 was likewise less readable than urologic organization PIMs with scores of 11-13.

links.outcome: Reading level of patient materials relative to general population reading ability
links.effect: Organizational PIMs grade 8-12 and GPT outputs grade 11-14, higher than the general population's reading ability.
links.quote: Current PIMs from major urologic organizations for kidney stones remain more readable than publicly available GPT outputs, but they are still higher than the reading ability of the general population.

unlisted_practices: Prompting the LLM to specify a target reading level (grade 6) to change output readability
